The token is -96.90% from its all-time high of $0.4774, recorded on December 25, 2024. Its all-time low is $0.0121, recorded on April 5, 2026, while the 30-day move is +13.36%. Circulating supply is 4,233,186,230.34, total supply is 8,888,888,888, and max supply is 8,888,888,888. The volume-to-market-cap ratio is 9.89%, which helps separate active markets from thin markets. A higher ratio usually means recent trading activity is easier to observe, while a very low ratio can make price changes less reliable as a signal.
